parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: own (default): only the caller's own organization's products. network: also includes products from organizations that granted the caller an active PRODUCT_DATA sharing grant scoped ALL_PRODUCTS or PRODUCT_CATEGORY (ADR-012 follow-up).
